name: feature
what: A feature is a unit of the registry: it declares commands, stages, tables, settings and the other entities listed here, under names it owns.

entries.name: textstyles
entries.summary: The inline formatting commands `\emph`, `\textbf`, `\textit` and `\texttt`: four values of the element type `flm.textstyle`, each lowered to a `flm.pres.span` node that carries its style.

entries.name: literals
entries.summary: The commands that stand for one character of text (`\%`, `\#`, `\&`, `\$`, `\ `, `\{`, `\}`, `\textbackslash`) and the special character sequence `~` for a non-breaking space: nine values of the element type `flm.literal`. Also `\@`, a hint about whether a period ends a sentence.

entries.name: blocks
entries.summary: Lays out every document tree in paragraphs and blocks, from the block role of each element and the layout it declares for its arguments and body, and resolves the text once: the `flm.blocks.structure` rewrite stage provides `flm.blocks.structured`; the `flm.blocks.raw` marker stage keeps the trees as parsed; the `flm.blocks.check-contract` stage checks the tree contract.

entries.name: index
entries.summary: The element index `flm.element-index`: for every tree, the nodes of the tree and the element each carries, in document order, so that a stage finds the nodes whose element carries an aspect without walking the tree.

entries.name: refpoints
entries.summary: The table `flm.refpoints`: every reference point of the run (a place that can be referred to, numbered or given an anchor), as its element declared it, in document order; the `refs` and `numbering` features read it.

entries.name: numbering
entries.summary: Counters, counter styles and the numbers of reference points: the five service slots into which features declare counters, counter styles, within-joiners, number writers and parent sets, the per-document numbering options, the stage that numbers, in document order, every reference point that has a number source, and the table `flm.counters` it writes.

entries.name: math
entries.summary: Mathematics: the display-math environments and their equation lines, the text commands of math mode, `\ensuremath`, `\eqref`, equation numbering, and the capabilities `flm.math.content` and `flm.math.rendered`. A feature that processes mathematics (`math-passthrough`) checks and lowers the formulas.

entries.name: refs
entries.summary: Labels and references: the `\ref` and `\hyperref` commands, the labels written after constructs, the link identifier of every reference point, the resolution of every reference, and the check of duplicate labels and label types.

entries.name: headings
entries.summary: Headings: one value of the element `flm.heading` per heading kind, written with the kind's heading commands (`\section` to `\subparagraph` by default); each heading carries a level, a reference point and its `\label` fields.

entries.name: verbatim
entries.summary: Content shown exactly as written: the macros `\verbtext`, `\verbcode` and `\verba` and the environments `verbatimtext` and `verbatimcode`, each lowered to a `flm.pres.verbatim` node that carries its verbatim kind and its language.

entries.name: lists
entries.summary: The list environments as element values of `flm.lists.list`, `\item` inside their bodies, the label shown beside each item, and one reference point per item.

entries.name: xnotes
entries.summary: Footnotes and the other kinds of xnote (notes set apart from the running text): the configured kinds and their commands, the two reference points of every xnote, the service slot `flm.xnotes.kinds` of the kinds, and the table `flm.xnotes` of every xnote of a document by kind.

entries.name: href
entries.summary: Links to an address outside the document: `\href{address}{text}`, `\url{address}` and `\email{address}`, lowering to `flm.pres.link` with the kind token `url`.

entries.name: defterm
entries.summary: Defined terms: the `defterm` environment, which defines a term and carries one reference point, and `\term`, a link to a term's definition, which the references feature resolves.

entries.name: theorems
entries.summary: Theorem-like environments (`theorem`, `lemma`, `proof`, …), one per configured kind, all of the element `flm.theorems.theorem`: each with an optional title, numbered and labeled where its kind's class is numbered, a heading at the start of its first paragraph, an optional closing mark, and, on a proof, a back-reference to the statement it proves.

entries.name: quote
entries.summary: Quotations: the quote environments (`quote`, `blockquote`, `address` and any a host configures), their quotation-section commands `\text`, `\lines`, `\attributed` and `\block`, and the commands `\\` and `\indent` of a lines section.

entries.name: annotations
entries.summary: A reviewer's marks: one command per configured annotator, written `\phf{…}` or `\phf … \endphf` for a highlighted passage and `\phf[…]` for a remark, with `phf` the annotator's command.

entries.name: graphics
entries.summary: Images, written `\includegraphics[options]{path}` inside the body of a float type that makes the command available (the `figure` and `table` types do) or, under `global`, wherever text can be written: inline content, except as a direct child of a float's body, where an image is a block. The file that a host's graphics resolver finds and what its inspector reports about it are recorded; each output publishes the image by reference, as a copy beside the output or written into a `data:` address, converted where a conversion rule says so. On the plain-text, HTML and rendered LaTeX outputs the image lowers to `flm.pres.image` with the published address, on the recomposed LaTeX to the LaTeX hook `\flmIncludeGraphics`.

entries.name: floats
entries.summary: Floats such as figures and tables: one environment per float type, each an element value of `flm.floats.float`, holding content with an optional caption, labels and a number given by the type's numbering policy.

entries.name: cells
entries.summary: The `cells` environment, inside a `table` float or, under `global`, wherever blocks can be written: a grid filled with `\cell` and `\celldata`, cells spanning rows or columns with `\merge`, names for rows and columns with `\rownames` and `\colnames`, and style tokens referring to the cell styles of the service slot `flm.cells.styles`.

entries.name: citations
entries.summary: Citing works by key: `\cite[note]{keys}`, adjacent calls read as one citation chunk, and `\R\cite{keys}`, a citation written as a noun of its sentence. The host's citation providers give each cited citation key its citation entry and say which citation keys refer to the same work; the works are numbered in order of first citation, each citation chunk is shown as a citation mark linking to its works, and the works are listed after the content, or their citation entries are shown in the citation marks.

entries.name: input
entries.summary: `\input{file}`: the content of another file, parsed where the command is written and put in place of the command by the rewrite `flm.input.splice`, which publishes `flm.input.spliced`.

entries.name: userdefs
entries.summary: Macros, environments and special character sequences defined by substitution. Each definition is an element carrying the `Expand` aspect. The rewrite stages `flm.userdefs.expand-always` and `flm.userdefs.expand` expand the use sites of the `always` and of the `per-plan` definitions; the `flm.userdefs.keep` marker stage keeps the latter in the tree instead. Every definition's `expand-in-tree` rule gives its element a rule on every backend; a `per-plan` definition's `emit-call` and `instantiate-at-lowering` rules lower a use site kept in the tree. The templates are compiled when the registry is built, which also records whether each definition can be written as one LaTeX definition.

entries.name: lowering
entries.summary: the presentation vocabulary, the field element and the structural elements' default lowering rules

entries.name: meta
entries.summary: The document's metadata (its title, its authors, its date and any other key) as an option set per document, and the three pieces that show the title, the authors and the date before the content.

entries.name: toc
entries.summary: The document's table of contents: the table `flm.toc.entries` of the listed headings, and the piece `flm.toc` (off by default) that shows them as nested lists before the content.

entries.name: pieces
entries.summary: the service slot into which features declare the document-level values a backend places before or after the content, and the render option that chooses which of them a render request places

entries.name: text
entries.summary: plain-text output over the layout engine: the `text` output and workflow

entries.name: latex
entries.summary: registers what every LaTeX backend shares: the LaTeX construct elements, the placeholder rule, the service slots through which a backend resolves LaTeX package requests and definition pieces, and the standard package definitions and definition pieces

entries.name: latex-recomposed
entries.summary: the document recomposed into LaTeX from the raw tree: the `latex-recomposed` output and workflow, a body and a style file

entries.name: latex-rendered
entries.summary: the document as fully resolved LaTeX for LuaLaTeX, written through one command or environment per presentation element: the `latex-rendered` output and workflow, a document and a style file

entries.name: html
entries.summary: HTML output for a browser: the construct element `flm.pres.html.tag`, the `html` backend, the `html` output and the `html` workflow

entries.name: check
entries.summary: The collection `flm.validated`, which every check joins, and the `check` workflow, which demands it: the document is validated and no output is written.

entries.name: math-passthrough
entries.summary: Mathematics carried to the output as written: unknown macros and environments in math mode kept as source (`flm.math-passthrough.opaque`), the check `flm.math.content`, which accepts every formula, and the lowering rules of the formulas on every backend. Requires the `math` feature.

name: package
what: A package is a named bundle of features, together with the packages it builds on, that a document or the program chooses to use.

name: element
what: An element type says what a node of a document's tree means; the nodes of every command carry an element of one type.

entries.name: flm.text
entries.summary: a run of text characters

entries.name: flm.comment
entries.summary: a source comment

entries.name: flm.container
entries.summary: a container that holds content without meaning anything itself

entries.name: flm.group
entries.summary: a `{…}` content group

entries.name: flm.math
entries.summary: a mathematics group

entries.name: flm.verbatim
entries.summary: a verbatim group, the parent of a run of raw text

entries.name: flm.opaque-wrapper
entries.summary: a group with no delimiters that holds parsed content kept as written

entries.name: flm.paragraph
entries.summary: a paragraph

entries.name: flm.parbreak
entries.summary: a paragraph break (a blank line in the source)

entries.name: flm.placeholder
entries.summary: a placeholder of a template (`#1`, `#{name}`), replaced by content when the template is expanded

entries.name: flm.unknown.macro
entries.summary: a macro the parse could not attribute to any feature, reported as an error

entries.name: flm.unknown.environment
entries.summary: an environment the parse could not attribute to any feature, reported as an error; its body is block content

entries.name: flm.textstyle
entries.summary: Semantic emphasis of its content.

entries.name: flm.literal
entries.summary: The character `%`, written `\%`.

entries.name: flm.sentence-spacing
entries.summary: A hint about the space after a period: whether that period ends a sentence. It produces no character.

entries.name: flm.math.environment
entries.summary: The `equation` display-math environment.

entries.name: flm.math.text
entries.summary: `\text{…}` inside mathematics: its argument is document content, read in text mode.

entries.name: flm.math.ensuremath
entries.summary: `\ensuremath{…}` in text: an inline formula, as `\(…\)`.

entries.name: flm.math.eqref
entries.summary: A reference to an equation line that shows its number in parentheses.

entries.name: flm.ref
entries.summary: A reference to a labeled place, showing its number, else its content, else the label.

entries.name: flm.hyperref
entries.summary: A reference to a labeled place, showing the text written for it.

entries.name: flm.heading
entries.summary: `section`: A heading of level 1.

entries.name: flm.field
entries.summary: The field `\label`, which the construct it is written after reads as data.

entries.name: flm.heading.number
entries.summary: The number of a numbered heading, where the kind's heading title template writes `#{number}`. No document can write it.

entries.name: flm.verbatim.macro
entries.summary: `\verbtext`: inline verbatim content of kind `text`.

entries.name: flm.verbatim.environment
entries.summary: `\begin{verbatimtext}…\end{verbatimtext}`: verbatim content of kind `text`.

entries.name: flm.lists.list
entries.summary: `description`: a list whose items are unnumbered.

entries.name: flm.xnotes.footnote.list
entries.summary: The list of the `footnote` xnotes of a document.

entries.name: flm.xnotes.xnote
entries.summary: `\footnote`: a note of the xnote kind `footnote`.

entries.name: flm.xnotes.entry
entries.summary: One entry of a list of xnotes, holding a pointer to the xnote's content.

entries.name: flm.xnotes.mark-of
entries.summary: The mark of an xnote, written in its place in content shown again.

entries.name: flm.xnotes.content-pointer
entries.summary: The content of an xnote, shown where this node is placed.

entries.name: flm.href.link
entries.summary: `\href`: a hyperlink to an address outside the document.

entries.name: flm.defterm
entries.summary: The definition of a term (the `defterm` environment), the target of the term links to that term.

entries.name: flm.field
entries.summary: The field `\label`, which the construct it is written after reads as data.

entries.name: flm.term
entries.summary: A link to the definition of a term, showing the text written for it.

entries.name: flm.defterm.term-pointer
entries.summary: The term of a term definition, shown where a lead-in template places `#{term}`; synthesized, never written in a document.

entries.name: flm.theorems.theorem
entries.summary: `conjecture`: a theorem-like environment of the theorem class `theoremlike`.

entries.name: flm.field
entries.summary: The field `\label`, which the construct it is written after reads as data.

entries.name: flm.theorems.name
entries.summary: The kind's word and the theorem's number in a theorem's heading; synthesized, never written in a document.

entries.name: flm.theorems.title-pointer
entries.summary: The title of a theorem, shown where its heading template places `#{title}`; synthesized, never written in a document.

entries.name: flm.theorems.relation
entries.summary: The statement a proof refers to, shown where its heading template places `#{title}`; synthesized, never written in a document.

entries.name: flm.quote
entries.summary: `address`: a quote environment, a quotation set apart from the running text.

entries.name: flm.floats.float
entries.summary: A float: one element value per float type, each written as the environment of the type's name.

entries.name: flm.citations.cite
entries.summary: A citation chunk, `\cite[note]{keys}`, attached to the content before it.

entries.name: flm.field
entries.summary: The field `\cite`, which the construct it is written after reads as data.

entries.name: flm.citations.refcite
entries.summary: A citation chunk written as a noun, `\R\cite{keys}`, after a word, `ref.~` or `refs.~` by default.

entries.name: flm.citations.bibliography
entries.summary: A list of cited works.

entries.name: flm.citations.bibliography.entry
entries.summary: One entry of a list of cited works.

entries.name: flm.input
entries.summary: `\input{file}`: the content of another file, brought in where the command is written.

entries.name: flm.field
entries.summary: A field: a macro that a construct absorbs as data rather than as content, such as the `\label` written after a heading; only the construct that declared the field reads it.

entries.name: flm.meta.title
entries.summary: The document's title.

entries.name: flm.meta.author
entries.summary: The document's authors, one author per child.

entries.name: flm.meta.author.name
entries.summary: One author of the document.

entries.name: flm.meta.date
entries.summary: The document's date.

entries.name: flm.toc
entries.summary: The table of contents: one list of entries.

entries.name: flm.toc.list
entries.summary: A list of entries of the table of contents.

entries.name: flm.toc.entry
entries.summary: One entry of the table of contents: the title, then the list of its sub-entries.

entries.name: flm.math-passthrough.opaque
entries.summary: A macro or environment that no feature declares, written in math mode: the node keeps its source as written, because mathematical notation uses an open-ended set of commands.

entries.name: flm.field
entries.summary: A `\\` inside a display-math environment: the end of an equation line, with the optional vertical spacing written after it.

entries.name: flm.field
entries.summary: A `\label{type:label}` inside an argument that accepts labels: a label attached to the construct the argument belongs to.

entries.name: flm.lists.item
entries.summary: `\item`: begins an item of the list in whose body it is written.

entries.name: flm.field
entries.summary: The field `\label`, which the construct it is written after reads as data.

entries.name: flm.quote.section
entries.summary: `\text{…}`: a text section of a quotation.

entries.name: flm.field
entries.summary: A `\\` inside a lines section of a quotation: the end of a line.

entries.name: flm.graphics.image
entries.summary: `\includegraphics[options]{path}`: an image the document shows.

entries.name: flm.field
entries.summary: A `\caption[alt=…]{…}` in a float's body: the float's caption.

entries.name: flm.cells.cells
entries.summary: `\begin{cells}…\end{cells}`: a table of cells.

entries.name: flm.cells.cell
entries.summary: `\cell<styles>[placement]{content}`: one cell of a table of cells.

entries.name: flm.cells.data
entries.summary: `\celldata<styles>[mapping]{data}`: several cells of a table of cells, by rows.

entries.name: flm.cells.row
entries.summary: `\\` in a table of cells: the next cell starts a new row.

entries.name: flm.cells.rownames
entries.summary: `\rownames{names}`: names for the rows of a table of cells.

entries.name: flm.cells.colnames
entries.summary: `\colnames{names}`: names for the columns of a table of cells.

entries.name: flm.cells.merge
entries.summary: `\merge{range}`: a span of rows or of columns, in a cell's placement.

entries.name: flm.cells.column
entries.summary: `&` in the data of `\celldata`: the end of an entry.

name: capability
what: A capability is a named condition that a stage brings about when it runs, such as a table having been written; a plan schedules the stages that provide the capabilities it needs.

entries.name: flm.blocks
entries.summary: A decision about block structure has been made: the trees are laid out in paragraphs and blocks (`flm.blocks.structured`, the default) or kept as parsed (`flm.blocks.raw`).

entries.name: flm.blocks.raw
entries.summary: The trees are kept as parsed: no paragraphs, and the text unresolved. The alternative to `flm.blocks.structured`; a plan that demands both is refused.

entries.name: flm.blocks.contract-checked
entries.summary: Every frozen tree satisfies the parts of the tree contract that the plan's trees are subject to, or its violations have been reported as `flm.blocks.contract-violated`. A member of `flm.validated`.

entries.name: flm.math.content
entries.summary: The mathematics of the document has been checked. No stage of the `math` feature provides it: a feature that processes mathematics provides it with a check of its own and adds that check to the collection `flm.validated` (the feature of the package `math-passthrough` accepts every formula).

entries.name: flm.math.rendered
entries.summary: Some rendered form of the mathematics exists. No standard feature provides it; an extension that renders mathematics provides a refinement.

entries.name: flm.refs.check-labels
entries.summary: The labels have been checked: every label written for two reference points and every label whose type its point does not accept has been reported as an Error, and every reference has been resolved, a reference that points at no label being reported.

entries.name: flm.theorems.check-proofs
entries.summary: The theorems have been checked: every statement expecting a proof that no proof refers back to and that carries no `\noproofref` was reported as a Warning, and every title that begins with a star but is not a well-formed back-reference as an Error. A member of `flm.validated`.

entries.name: flm.floats.check-handlers
entries.summary: Each content handler that a float type used in the document lists, and that no registered feature contributes, has been reported once. A member of `flm.validated`.

entries.name: flm.citations.check
entries.summary: The citations have been checked: every cited key with no citation entry was reported as an Error. A member of `flm.validated`.

entries.name: flm.userdefs
entries.summary: A decision about the `per-plan` user definitions has been made: their use sites are expanded in the tree (`flm.userdefs.expanded`, the default) or kept in the tree for the lowering rules (`flm.userdefs.kept`).

entries.name: flm.userdefs.kept
entries.summary: The use sites of the `per-plan` user definitions are kept in the tree, for a lowering rule to expand or to write as a call. The alternative to `flm.userdefs.expanded`; a plan that demands both is refused.

entries.name: flm.meta.read
entries.summary: The document's metadata has been parsed, and every problem the parse found has been reported. A member of `flm.validated`.

entries.name: flm.output.html.singlefile
entries.summary: the page written as one HTML file

entries.name: flm.blocks.structured
entries.summary: Lays out each tree in paragraphs and blocks, from the block role of each element and the layout it declares for its arguments and body, and resolves the text once. Publishes the trees as `flm.blocks.structured`, the default refinement of `flm.blocks`.

entries.name: flm.element-index
entries.summary: For every tree, every node whose element a feature registered, in document order, with the number the registry assigned to that element.

entries.name: flm.refpoints
entries.summary: Every reference point that a node's element declares through the `Referenceable` aspect, whole, in document order, with lookup by the point's identity.

entries.name: flm.counters
entries.summary: Every reference point the numbering stage read, with its counter, its counter value, the counters it is numbered within and its counter style, or nothing for a point that is not numbered.

entries.name: flm.labels
entries.summary: For every label, the reference point that keeps it; the labels written more than once; and the labels whose type their point does not accept.

entries.name: flm.anchors
entries.summary: Every reference point's anchor (the identifier a link points at), formed from its first label, its title, its position or its number, or given by its element, or none when the point has nothing to form it from or an earlier point holds the same one.

entries.name: flm.refs.targets
entries.summary: For every label whose point received an anchor: the reference point that keeps it, its link target (`#` and the anchor) and what a reference to it shows; read by the resolve stage.

entries.name: flm.refs.resolutions
entries.summary: How every reference site resolved: to a reference point of this document, to a label of another document from the external index, or not at all.

entries.name: flm.refs.external-index
entries.summary: Labels of other documents, each with its link target and the content a reference to it shows; installed by the caller when the run is constructed, and read only when installed.

entries.name: flm.labels.safe
entries.summary: For the recomposed LaTeX: the safe label (`ref1`, `ref2`, …) written in place of every label whose type is not written raw, numbered in the order the document first mentions the labels, and the reverse correspondence.

entries.name: flm.labels.safe.value
entries.summary: For the recomposed LaTeX: for every reference node of a synthesized value, the name written for each target that has no safe label in the document (`ref-v1`, …); held in the value's catch-up store, and empty for a document tree.

entries.name: flm.xnotes.list.footnote
entries.summary: The list of the `footnote` xnotes of the document: a synthesized value, or nothing to place.

entries.name: flm.xnotes
entries.summary: Every xnote of the document, by xnote kind, in document order: its reference point and the reference point of its mark.

entries.name: flm.graphics.info
entries.summary: what is known about each image, by node address: its path, its origin, the file the resolver found and the inspector's result, completed

entries.name: flm.graphics.published.text
entries.summary: the address the `text` backend writes for each image, by node address

entries.name: flm.graphics.published.html
entries.summary: the address the `html` backend writes for each image, by node address

entries.name: flm.graphics.published.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: the address the `latex-recomposed` backend writes for each image, by node address

entries.name: flm.graphics.published.latex-rendered
entries.summary: the address the `latex-rendered` backend writes for each image, by node address

entries.name: flm.citations.keys
entries.summary: Every citation key the document cites, once, in order of first citation, with where it is first cited.

entries.name: flm.citations
entries.summary: The cited works of the document: for each citation key, the work it refers to, with the work's number (in order of the first citation of any of its keys), its identifier `citation-<n>` and its identity.

entries.name: flm.citations.entries
entries.summary: The citation entries of the cited works: for each citation key, its citation entry or the reason it has none.

entries.name: flm.citations.bibliography
entries.summary: The list of the cited works of the document, as a synthesized value, or nothing to place.

entries.name: flm.input.spliced
entries.summary: Replaces every `\input` whose file was brought in by the file's content, in place of the command among its sibling nodes. Publishes the trees as `flm.input.spliced`; runs before the expansion of user definitions and before block structure.

entries.name: flm.userdefs.always-expanded
entries.summary: Expands the use sites of the user definitions whose expansion policy is `always`. Publishes the trees as `flm.userdefs.always-expanded`, a capability that goes with either alternative of `flm.userdefs`. The lowering rule of every `always` definition requires it, so this stage is in every plan that lowers a registry holding such a definition.

entries.name: flm.userdefs.expanded
entries.summary: Expands the use sites of the user definitions whose expansion policy is `per-plan`. Publishes the trees as `flm.userdefs.expanded`, the default refinement of `flm.userdefs`. Runs after `flm.userdefs.expand-always` when both are in the plan.

entries.name: flm.meta.title
entries.summary: The document's title, parsed: its content, or nothing to place.

entries.name: flm.meta.author
entries.summary: The document's authors, parsed: their content, or nothing to place.

entries.name: flm.meta.date
entries.summary: The document's date, parsed: its content, or nothing to place.

entries.name: flm.toc.entries
entries.summary: The document's listed headings, in document order: each heading's address, level, first reference point and the content its entry shows.

entries.name: flm.toc
entries.summary: The table of contents as nested lists, or nothing to place.

entries.name: flm.lowered.text
entries.summary: the text backend's lowered trees, one per document tree

entries.name: flm.lowered.text.pieces
entries.summary: the pieces that the render request places, lowered for the text backend

entries.name: flm.output.text.regions
entries.summary: the output's one region: the printed text

entries.name: flm.output.text
entries.summary: the printed text and its position marks, which record where each presentation node was printed

entries.name: flm.output.text.document
entries.summary: the printed text as a one-artifact set

entries.name: flm.lowered.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: the recomposed backend's lowered trees, one per document tree

entries.name: flm.output.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: per tree: the recomposed LaTeX, the characters it declares, the requirement identifiers it needs

entries.name: flm.latex-recomposed.packages
entries.summary: the package identifiers the recomposed trees require

entries.name: flm.latex-recomposed.preamble
entries.summary: the definition pieces the recomposed trees require and the user definitions they recomposed

entries.name: flm.output.latex-recomposed.document
entries.summary: the recomposed LaTeX and its style file as an artifact set

entries.name: flm.lowered.latex-recomposed.pieces
entries.summary: the pieces that the render request places, lowered for the recomposed backend

entries.name: flm.output.latex-recomposed.regions
entries.summary: the body, the pieces and the style file's package name

entries.name: flm.output.latex-recomposed.style
entries.summary: the style file beside the recomposed LaTeX, where it has one

entries.name: flm.element-index
entries.summary: For every tree, every node whose element a feature registered, in document order, with the number the registry assigned to that element.

entries.name: flm.refpoints
entries.summary: Every reference point that a node's element declares through the `Referenceable` aspect, whole, in document order, with lookup by the point's identity.

entries.name: flm.counters
entries.summary: Every reference point the numbering stage read, with its counter, its counter value, the counters it is numbered within and its counter style, or nothing for a point that is not numbered.

entries.name: flm.labels
entries.summary: For every label, the reference point that keeps it; the labels written more than once; and the labels whose type their point does not accept.

entries.name: flm.anchors
entries.summary: Every reference point's anchor (the identifier a link points at), formed from its first label, its title, its position or its number, or given by its element, or none when the point has nothing to form it from or an earlier point holds the same one.

entries.name: flm.refs.targets
entries.summary: For every label whose point received an anchor: the reference point that keeps it, its link target (`#` and the anchor) and what a reference to it shows; read by the resolve stage.

entries.name: flm.refs.resolutions
entries.summary: How every reference site resolved: to a reference point of this document, to a label of another document from the external index, or not at all.

entries.name: flm.refs.external-index
entries.summary: Labels of other documents, each with its link target and the content a reference to it shows; installed by the caller when the run is constructed, and read only when installed.

entries.name: flm.labels.safe
entries.summary: For the recomposed LaTeX: the safe label (`ref1`, `ref2`, …) written in place of every label whose type is not written raw, numbered in the order the document first mentions the labels, and the reverse correspondence.

entries.name: flm.labels.safe.value
entries.summary: For the recomposed LaTeX: for every reference node of a synthesized value, the name written for each target that has no safe label in the document (`ref-v1`, …); held in the value's catch-up store, and empty for a document tree.

entries.name: flm.xnotes.list.footnote

entries.name: flm.xnotes
entries.summary: Every xnote of the document, by xnote kind, in document order: its reference point and the reference point of its mark.

entries.name: flm.graphics.info

entries.name: flm.citations.entries

entries.name: flm.citations.bibliography

entries.name: flm.input.spliced

entries.name: flm.userdefs.always-expanded

entries.name: flm.userdefs.expanded

name: collection
what: A collection is a name for a set of capabilities: demanding the collection demands every member.

entries.name: flm.validated
entries.summary: Every check the registry's features add has run. The standard features add `flm.blocks.contract-checked`, `flm.refs.check-labels`, `flm.theorems.check-proofs`, `flm.floats.check-handlers`, `flm.citations.check`, `flm.meta.read` and `flm.input.spliced`; the feature that processes mathematics adds its check (`math-passthrough` adds `flm.math.content`). Demanding the collection demands every member.

name: stage
what: A stage is one step of the processing of a document: it rewrites the trees, computes a table, checks something, or writes output.

entries.name: flm.blocks.structure
entries.summary: Lays out each tree in paragraphs and blocks, from the block role of each element and the layout it declares for its arguments and body, and resolves the text once. Publishes the trees as `flm.blocks.structured`, the default refinement of `flm.blocks`.

entries.name: flm.blocks.raw
entries.summary: Does nothing and provides `flm.blocks.raw`, so that a plan that requires the trees as parsed excludes the `flm.blocks.structure` rewrite stage.

entries.name: flm.blocks.check-contract
entries.summary: Checks every frozen tree against the parts of the tree contract that apply to the plan's trees, and reports each violation as `flm.blocks.contract-violated`.

entries.name: flm.index.build
entries.summary: Walks the frozen tree once in document order and records every node whose element a feature registered into `flm.element-index`.

entries.name: flm.refpoints.scan
entries.summary: Asks every node whose element carries the `Referenceable` aspect for its reference points, once, and records each point whole, in document order, into `flm.refpoints`.

entries.name: flm.numbering.number
entries.summary: Advances the declared counters over the reference points of the document, in document order, and records each point's counter value in `flm.counters`.

entries.name: flm.refs.scan
entries.summary: Records in `flm.labels`, from the reference points of `flm.refpoints` in document order, which point keeps each label, the labels written twice and the labels whose type their point does not accept; reports labels and reference targets not spelled `type:label`.

entries.name: flm.refs.anchors
entries.summary: Gives every reference point its anchor (the identifier a link points at), formed from its label, its title, its position or its number, into `flm.anchors`, reporting two points with the same anchor; writes, for every label whose point received an anchor, its point, its link target and the content a reference shows, into `flm.refs.targets`.

entries.name: flm.refs.resolve
entries.summary: Resolves every reference site against the labels of the document and of the external index, into `flm.refs.resolutions`; reports every reference that points at no label.

entries.name: flm.refs.check-labels
entries.summary: Reports every label written for two reference points and every label whose type its point does not accept; it reads the resolutions so that the resolve stage runs and its reports of unresolved references come with the check.

entries.name: flm.refs.safe-labels
entries.summary: For the recomposed LaTeX: allocates the safe label (`ref1`, `ref2`, …) of every label a reference point carries and of every reference target, resolved or not, in the order the document first mentions it, into `flm.labels.safe`.

entries.name: flm.refs.value-safe-labels
entries.summary: For the recomposed LaTeX, over a synthesized value spliced at lowering: gives every target its references mention that has no safe label in `flm.labels.safe` a value name, `ref-v1`, `ref-v2`, … in the order the value first mentions it, into `flm.labels.safe.value`; writes nothing over a document tree.

entries.name: flm.xnotes.build-list.footnote
entries.summary: Builds the list of the `footnote` xnotes of the document: a synthesized value holding one entry per xnote, each a pointer to the xnote's content, written into the piece `flm.xnotes.list.footnote`.

entries.name: flm.xnotes.collect
entries.summary: Records every xnote of the document (a reference point whose kind is an xnote kind's name, followed on the same node by the point of its mark) into `flm.xnotes`, by kind and in document order, each with the region of its content. Reports the numbered kinds that no numbering feature numbers, and the nodes whose number of xnotes of a kind differs from their number of regions holding an xnote's content.

entries.name: flm.theorems.check-proofs
entries.summary: Reports every statement of a kind expecting a proof that no proof's back-reference resolves to and that carries no `\noproofref` (a Warning), and every title beginning with a star that is not a well-formed back-reference (an Error).

entries.name: flm.graphics.inspect
entries.summary: Asks the host's graphics resolver and inspector, where they are registered, about every image, and records the file found and the inspector's result, completed, by node address into `flm.graphics.info`.

entries.name: flm.graphics.publish.text
entries.summary: Writes the address that the `text` backend writes for each image, as the output's strategy decides it, into `flm.graphics.published.text`.

entries.name: flm.graphics.publish.html
entries.summary: Writes the address that the `html` backend writes for each image, as the output's strategy decides it, into `flm.graphics.published.html`, and the copies of image files into `flm.output.html.artifacts`.

entries.name: flm.graphics.publish.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: Writes the address that the `latex-recomposed` backend writes for each image, as the output's strategy decides it, into `flm.graphics.published.latex-recomposed`, and the copies of image files into `flm.output.latex-recomposed.artifacts`.

entries.name: flm.graphics.publish.latex-rendered
entries.summary: Writes the address that the `latex-rendered` backend writes for each image, as the output's strategy decides it, into `flm.graphics.published.latex-rendered`, and the copies of image files into `flm.output.latex-rendered.artifacts`.

entries.name: flm.floats.check-handlers
entries.summary: Reports, once per run, each content handler that a float type used in the document lists and that no registered feature contributes (a Note, at the first float of the type).

entries.name: flm.citations.collect
entries.summary: Records every citation key that the document's `\cite` and `\R` commands cite, in order of first citation, with where it is first cited, into `flm.citations.keys`.

entries.name: flm.citations.retrieve
entries.summary: Asks the citation providers of `flm.citations.providers`, in order, about every citation key the document cites and writes their citation entries into `flm.citations.entries`; then numbers the cited works, in order of first citation, into `flm.citations`.

entries.name: flm.citations.check
entries.summary: Reports, as an Error, every citation key the document cites that has no citation entry in `flm.citations.entries`.

entries.name: flm.citations.build-bibliography
entries.summary: Builds the list of the cited works, in the order of their numbers, each with its citation entry, into the piece `flm.citations.bibliography`.

entries.name: flm.input.splice
entries.summary: Replaces every `\input` whose file was brought in by the file's content, in place of the command among its sibling nodes. Publishes the trees as `flm.input.spliced`; runs before the expansion of user definitions and before block structure.

entries.name: flm.userdefs.expand-always
entries.summary: Expands the use sites of the user definitions whose expansion policy is `always`. Publishes the trees as `flm.userdefs.always-expanded`, a capability that goes with either alternative of `flm.userdefs`. The lowering rule of every `always` definition requires it, so this stage is in every plan that lowers a registry holding such a definition.

entries.name: flm.userdefs.expand
entries.summary: Expands the use sites of the user definitions whose expansion policy is `per-plan`. Publishes the trees as `flm.userdefs.expanded`, the default refinement of `flm.userdefs`. Runs after `flm.userdefs.expand-always` when both are in the plan.

entries.name: flm.userdefs.keep
entries.summary: Does nothing and provides `flm.userdefs.kept`, so that a plan that requires the use sites of the `per-plan` user definitions kept in the tree excludes the `flm.userdefs.expand` rewrite stage, and those use sites reach the lowering rules.

entries.name: flm.meta.build
entries.summary: Parses the document's title, authors and date as inline content and builds the pieces `flm.meta.title`, `flm.meta.author` and `flm.meta.date`.

entries.name: flm.toc.build
entries.summary: Lists the document's headings that the table of contents shows, in document order, into `flm.toc.entries`, and builds the table of contents as nested lists into the piece `flm.toc`.

entries.name: flm.text.pieces
entries.summary: lowers every piece that the render request places for the `text` backend

entries.name: flm.text.regions
entries.summary: writes the printed text as the output's one region into `flm.output.text.regions`

entries.name: flm.text.lower
entries.summary: lowers every frozen tree for the `text` backend

entries.name: flm.text.emit
entries.summary: prints the text backend's lowered trees as one text, with a position mark for each printed presentation node, into `flm.output.text`

entries.name: flm.text.final
entries.summary: writes the content region as the one-artifact set `flm.output.text.document`

entries.name: flm.latex-recomposed.pieces
entries.summary: lowers every piece that the render request places for the `latex-recomposed` backend

entries.name: flm.latex-recomposed.regions
entries.summary: emits the pieces, assembles the style file from the requirements into `flm.output.latex-recomposed.style`, and writes the body, the pieces and the style file's name as the regions `flm.output.latex-recomposed.regions`

entries.name: flm.latex-recomposed.lower
entries.summary: lowers every frozen tree for the `latex-recomposed` backend

entries.name: flm.latex-recomposed.emit
entries.summary: writes the recomposed backend's lowered tree as LaTeX: the recomposed LaTeX per tree, the package identifiers, the definition pieces and the recomposed user definitions

entries.name: flm.latex-recomposed.final
entries.summary: writes the body and the style file as the artifact set `flm.output.latex-recomposed.document`

entries.name: flm.latex-rendered.pieces
entries.summary: lowers every piece that the render request places for the `latex-rendered` backend

entries.name: flm.latex-rendered.emit-pieces
entries.summary: writes each lowered piece's LaTeX into `flm.output.latex-rendered.pieces`

entries.name: flm.latex-rendered.regions
entries.summary: resolves the requirements, assembles the style file into `flm.output.latex-rendered.style`, and writes the content, the pieces and the style file's package name as the regions `flm.output.latex-rendered.regions`

entries.name: flm.latex-rendered.lower
entries.summary: lowers every frozen tree for the `latex-rendered` backend

entries.name: flm.latex-rendered.emit
entries.summary: writes each lowered tree's LaTeX, its requirements and the definitions it staged into `flm.output.latex-rendered`

entries.name: flm.latex-rendered.final
entries.summary: writes the document in the backend's fixed skeleton, with its style file, as the artifact set `flm.output.latex-rendered.document`

entries.name: flm.html.resolve-definitions
entries.summary: resolves the stylesheets and scripts that the document's trees and pieces required, the ones the host requires, and the host's deliveries, into `flm.html.definitions`

entries.name: flm.html.pieces
entries.summary: lowers every piece that the render request places for the `html` backend

entries.name: flm.html.emit-pieces
entries.summary: writes each lowered piece's HTML, and the stylesheets and scripts it requires, into `flm.output.html.pieces`

entries.name: flm.html.regions
entries.summary: makes the page's regions — the content, the pieces, the stylesheets, the scripts, the title's words and the language — into `flm.output.html.regions`

entries.name: flm.html.lower
entries.summary: lowers every frozen tree for the `html` backend

entries.name: flm.html.emit
entries.summary: writes each lowered tree's HTML, and the stylesheets and scripts it requires, into `flm.output.html`

entries.name: flm.html.final.singlefile
entries.summary: assembles the page from the regions in the backend's own layout and writes it as the entry artifact of `flm.output.html.document`

entries.name: flm.math-passthrough.check
entries.summary: The check of passthrough mathematics: it accepts every formula as written, reports every equation line that holds no mathematics as `flm.math-passthrough.empty-line`, and provides `flm.math.content`.

name: lowering-rule
what: A lowering rule turns the nodes of one element type into elements that a backend writes natively.

entries.name: flm.textstyle.lower.default
entries.summary: a formatting command lowers to `flm.pres.span` carrying its style

entries.name: flm.textstyle.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: a formatting command lowers to the LaTeX macro of the same name over its argument

entries.name: flm.literal.lower.default
entries.summary: a literal lowers to a text node holding the character it stands for

entries.name: flm.sentence-spacing.lower.default
entries.summary: `\@` lowers to nothing

entries.name: flm.literal.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: a literal lowers to a raw node holding its spelling as written

entries.name: flm.sentence-spacing.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: `\@` lowers to a raw node holding `\@`

entries.name: flm.math.text.lower.default
entries.summary: a text command of math mode lowers to a `flm.pres.math-text` node that carries its name, over its argument lowered through the rules

entries.name: flm.math.ensuremath.lower.default
entries.summary: `\ensuremath` lowers to its argument lowered through the rules: in text an inline formula, inside mathematics the mathematics it holds

entries.name: flm.math.text.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: a text command of math mode lowers to the LaTeX macro of the same name, over its argument lowered as document text

entries.name: flm.math.eqref.lower.default
entries.summary: an `\eqref` lowers to what `\ref[noprefix]` lowers to for the same label: the line's number in parentheses, inside a link to the equation line

entries.name: flm.math.eqref.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: an `\eqref` lowers to the LaTeX `\eqref` around its label's safe label

entries.name: flm.math.environment.lower.default
entries.summary: a display-math environment that no feature processes is an Error, and lowers to a `flm.pres.span` of role `flm.math` over the content of its equation lines lowered as ordinary content

entries.name: flm.ref.lower.default
entries.summary: a `\ref` lowers to one `flm.pres.link` per resolved target, around the target's number, its content or its label, and to a `flm.pres.span` styled as unresolved around the text of a target that nothing resolves

entries.name: flm.hyperref.lower.default
entries.summary: a `\hyperref` lowers to a `flm.pres.link` around the text the author wrote when its target resolves, and to a `flm.pres.span` styled as unresolved around the same text when it does not

entries.name: flm.ref.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: a `\ref` lowers to the LaTeX hook `\flmRef` (or to `\zcref` with the latex-recomposed backend's render option `label_hooks` off) around the safe labels of its targets, its options as an optional argument

entries.name: flm.hyperref.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: a `\hyperref` lowers to the LaTeX hook `\flmHyperref` (or to `\hyperref` with the latex-recomposed backend's render option `label_hooks` off) around the safe label of its target and the author's text, recomposed as content

entries.name: flm.heading.number.lower.default
entries.summary: a heading's number lowers to `flm.pres.span` of role `flm.heading.number` around the number

entries.name: flm.heading.lower.default
entries.summary: a heading lowers to `flm.pres.block-heading` carrying its kind's name and level, whether it is listed in a table of contents, and its anchor, or, for a run-in kind, to a `flm.pres.deco.runin` decoration holding a `flm.pres.runin-heading` with the same payload; a numbered heading's content begins with its number

entries.name: flm.heading.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: a heading lowers to the LaTeX hook `\flmHeading[toc=…]` (with `alt={…}` where the heading has an alternative title), a newline, the LaTeX sectioning command its heading kind maps to, starred when not numbered, and a group holding the labels it read from its `\label` fields

entries.name: flm.heading.number.lower.latex-recomposed
entries.summary: a heading's number lowers to its content; the heading itself is written back as its sectioning command, so the number never reaches this backend

entries.name: flm.verbatim.macro.lower.default
entries.summary: a verbatim macro lowers to an inline `flm.pres.verbatim` node carrying its verbatim kind and language, over the characters of its content argument

entries.name: flm.verbatim.environment.lower.default
